description: This file defines the main app component for a Next.js frontend. It handles document uploads, orchestrates persona generation via backend API calls, manages app state (initial, processing, draft, finalized), renders UI for uploading files, viewing and editing persona details, version history, and handles polling for build status updates. It contains UI logic, state management, and integration with various backend API functions.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Represents a work experience entry within the PersonaData.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: UI representation of persona details, including name, title, skills, experiences, education, certifications, tools, industries, years of experience, and career highlights.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Information about uploaded files, including unique id and File object.
